tldr: North Node in scorpio: growth through depth, trust, shared power, and emotional courage.
body: This nodal axis asks the person to develop depth, trust, shared power, and emotional courage. The South Node in taurus shows the familiar route: comfort, possession, stagnation, and staying because change feels expensive. The work is not to reject the South Node completely, but to stop letting it run automatically. The North Node becomes stronger through repeated, conscious choices to enter the truth instead of managing the surface.
business: Growth accelerates when the person practices depth, trust, shared power, and emotional courage in real decisions, relationships, work, and daily habits.
shadow: Under stress, the South Node in taurus can pull the person back into comfort, possession, stagnation, and staying because change feels expensive.
policy: Read as a nodal axis: North Node sign names the growth medicine; South Node sign names the familiar pattern. Do not treat either node as a planet or deterministic fate.
